prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished luxury Korean fantasy strategy game renewal announcement POSTER, native portrait 2:3 1024x1536 or larger. This is a premium, very concise poster for 숲켓몬's territorial war renewal.

Input reference 1 is the actual newly illustrated war map: retain its snowy northern mountains/stone bridge, central crossroads, southern turquoise river/forest, cool western land and warm red eastern land. References 2 and 3 are the actual two faction castles: retain the silver ivory cyan-blue winged guardian fortress and the garnet rose-gold crimson crystal fortress. These project resources must be recognizable in the poster. Compose the two elegant castles facing each other across the map in the lower-middle artwork, one cool and one warm, with subtle connecting paths/nine small strategic points suggested artistically in the landscape. No character portraits, no generic armies or modern guns, no additional logo artwork.

Design an elegant editorial-quality fantasy game campaign poster. Deep midnight navy/charcoal, silver-cyan and wine-crimson tension with restrained champagne-gold typography/line details. Cinematic richly painted land, beautiful castles, controlled luminous embers, crisp details, no milky fog or white screen wash. Tasteful understated golden top/bottom rules, rich negative space, balanced hierarchy. NOT a busy UI screenshot, not stacks of rounded panels, not a cheap neon ad. The map should occupy most of the middle; typography upper third and three brief text lines in calm dark space at the bottom. No unnecessary copy.

Render this exact Korean text legibly with excellent Korean typography and correct characters:
Small top brand: "숲켓몬"
Main title, very large and beautifully spaced: "영토전 리뉴얼"
Hero slogan below title: "다시 전장으로 !"
Bottom short renewal copy, three distinct lines:
"9개 거점 · 세 갈래 전선"
"개인 균형 편성 · 아군 전용 지휘"
"신규 전술 3종 추가"

Main title in bold refined Korean display lettering with subtle metallic champagne finish, slogan in clean off-white, small text clean Korean sans-serif with generous line spacing. No extra English text. Spell every Korean syllable exactly as quoted. No invented launch date, no OPEN NOW, no prize amounts, no false release claim, no QR code, no CTA button, no watermark. High readability at phone size. Keep all text comfortably inside safe margins. A stylish finished poster suitable for sharing directly.
